cluster_fsid.description: UUID of the Ceph cluster. Must be generated once and reused across all nodes in the cluster.

monitor_initial_members.description:
List of monitor hostnames/names that should be part of the initial monitor quorum.
items:
  type: string
  description: A monitor node hostname (e.g., 'ceph-mon-01').

monitor_host.description:
List of monitor addresses (hostname or IP) used to reach monitors. Usually derived from monitor hosts.
items:
  type: string
  description: Monitor reachable address:hostname or IP:port (e.g., '192.168.1.10:6789').

log_file_path.description: Path template for log files. Use $cluster_name, $type, $id as placeholders.

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors allowed for Ceph daemons.

public_network.description: CIDR or IP range for the public (client-facing) network. Required for proper node discovery.

cluster_network.description: CIDR or IP range for the cluster (internal replication traffic) network. Optional but recommended for production.

auth_cluster_required.description: Authentication protocol required for cluster daemons (e.g., mon, osd) to talk to each other.

auth_service_required.description: Authentication protocol required for services (e.g., mgr, mds, rgw) to authenticate to the cluster.

auth_client_required.description: Authentication protocol required for clients (e.g., rados, CephFS, RBD) to access the cluster.

mon_clock_drift_allowed.description: Maximum clock drift (seconds) allowed between monitors before quorum is broken.

mon_clock_drift_warn_extra_allowed.description: Clock drift (seconds) threshold above which warnings are logged but quorum is not broken.

osd_journal_size.description: Size (MB) of the journal for each BlueStore OSD (if using filestore/journal fallback or legacy).

osd_op_threads.description: Number of threads used for OSD operations. Increase for SSDs/NVMe with high IOPS.

osd_max_object_name_len.description: Maximum length (in characters) of an object name in RADOS.

osd_max_object_namespace_len.description: Maximum length (in characters) of an object namespace string.

rgw_enabled.description: Enable the RADOS Gateway (RGW) service for S3/Swift-compatible object storage.

rgw_frontends.description: RGW frontend configuration string (e.g., 'civetweb port=80 port=443 ssl_certificate=/etc/ssl/rgw.crt').

rgw_dns_name.description: DNS name used for the RGW service (for virtual-host-style bucket access).

monitors.description:
List of monitor daemon entries. Usually auto-populated by cephadm, but can override.
items:
  type: object
  properties:
    name:
      type: string
      description: Monitor name (e.g., 'a', 'b', 'mon0').
    host:
      type: string
      description: Hostname or IP of the host running the monitor daemon.
    address:
      type: string
      description: Monitor address and port in 'host:port' format.
  required:
  - name
  - host
  - address

osds.description:
Explicit OSD entries (rarely used with cephadm; cephadm auto-adds OSDs from devices).
items:
  type: object
  properties:
    id:
      type: number
      description: OSD ID (e.g., 0, 1).
    host:
      type: string
      description: Hostname of the host where the OSD daemon runs.
    device:
      type: string
      description: Block device path (e.g., /dev/nvme0n1) — used for bluestore DB/WAL separation.
  required:
  - id
  - host

mdss.description:
List of Metadata Server (MDS) daemon entries for CephFS.
items:
  type: object
  properties:
    name:
      type: string
      description: MDS daemon name (e.g., 'a', 'ceph-mds-1').
    host:
      type: string
      description: Hostname of the host running the MDS.
  required:
  - name
  - host

rgws.description:
List of explicit RGW daemon entries (for multi-instance RGW setups).
items:
  type: object
  properties:
    name:
      type: string
      description: RGW instance name (e.g., 'a', 'gateway-1').
    host:
      type: string
      description: Hostname of the host running this RGW instance.
    frontends:
      type: string
      description: RGW frontend config for this instance (e.g., 'civetweb port=8080').
  required:
  - name
  - host
  - frontends

mgrs.description:
List of explicit manager daemon entries (cephadm usually auto-deploys).
items:
  type: object
  properties:
    name:
      type: string
      description: Manager daemon name (e.g., 'a', 'mgr0').
    host:
      type: string
      description: Hostname of the host running the manager daemon.
  required:
  - name
  - host
